data.one_liner: A new way to fit children of Wrap using Wrap2 and Wrapped widgets.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a new way to fit children of a Wrap widget. It allows developers to stretch a child of Wrap2 to fill the remaining space of the current run using different WrapFit options.
use_when: You need to stretch children of a Wrap widget to fill remaining run space
You want to use features from Flutter PR #136161 before they land in stable Flutter
avoid_when: The WrapFit feature becomes natively available in the stable Flutter release
You are concerned about packages that might be archived if an upstream PR is not merged
strengths: Allows fine-grained control over wrapping behavior with runTight, runLoose, tight, and loose fits
Simple migration path to stable Flutter implementation when available
weaknesses: May be archived once the feature is available in stable Flutter or if the upstream PR does not get merged
Relies on a non-standard Wrap2 and Wrapped replacement rather than enhancing the core Flutter Wrap
data.setup_notes: Add the package to dependencies and replace Wrap with Wrap2.
